faq.a: For a big group, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) offers a flybridge, saloon, and free jet ski. For a couple or small family, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) is cosy and affordable from €749/2h.

faq.q: How much does a yacht charter cost on New Year's Eve 2029?

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?

data.body_html:
Welcome 2029 in style with a marbella yacht charter new years eve 2029. Watch the Puerto Banús fireworks reflect off the Mediterranean while you sip cava on a private yacht. Our fleet of over 15 boats departs from Puerto Banús, Marbella's superyacht marina, with licensed skipper, drinks, and snacks included. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on a Tier A yacht – no hidden fees, just a spectacular night on the water.

Why a Yacht for New Year's Eve?

Marbella's New Year's Eve fireworks are launched from the pier at Puerto Banús. From a yacht, you get an unobstructed view of the show, away from the crowded promenade. The sea breeze keeps the air fresh, and your private boat means no queues for drinks or toilets. Plus, you can anchor at Cala del Faro or off the Golden Mile for a quieter spot.

Our Fleet for NYE 2029

Choose from our selection of motor yachts, catamarans, and speedboats. All depart from Puerto Banús. Tier A boats are ideal for small groups; Tier B boats offer more space and a free jet ski.

What's Included

Every charter includes: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No extra costs. Just bring your party spirit.

Recommended Itinerary for NYE

  • 10:30 PM – Board at Puerto Banús, welcome cava.
  • 11:00 PM – Cruise along the coast towards Cabopino or Estepona.
  • 11:45 PM – Anchor near the harbour for fireworks.
  • 12:00 AM – Countdown, fireworks, toast with champagne.
  • 12:30 AM – Return to port or extend the party.

How to Book

New Year's Eve slots are limited. Book early via WhatsApp or our online form. For Tier A boats, payment secures your slot. For Tier B and other boats, we'll send a custom quote. Check our Marbella yacht charter page for the full fleet.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best boat for a New Year's Eve party in Marbella?

For a big group, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) offers a flybridge, saloon, and free jet ski. For a couple or small family, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) is cosy and affordable from €749/2h.

How much does a yacht charter cost on New Year's Eve 2029?

Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours. Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80 cost €4,719 minimum for 4 hours. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

What is included in the charter price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No extra charges.

Can we see the Puerto Banús fireworks from the yacht?

Yes. Most yachts anchor near the harbour entrance or just off the beach, giving you front-row views of the midnight fireworks over Puerto Banús and the Golden Mile.

Capacity varies: Dubhe (5 pax), Astondoa 40 (9 pax), Azimut 39 (11 pax), Mangusta 80 (12 pax), Ferretti 94 (12 pax). Check each boat's profile for exact numbers.
